event_chain.summary: Misdelivery - canvass email link exposed voter spreadsheet

summary: On 27 July 2026, Nuneaton and Bedworth Borough Council sent an annual electoral canvass email asking electors to review their property details; due to an administrative error the email contained a link to a spreadsheet exposing about 2,900 voters' first names, surnames, email addresses and household-specific unique access codes for the online canvass portal (Arbury ward). The council disabled the link once the error was identified, contacted affected residents and reported the incident to the ICO.
